verses.1: The LORD said to Noah, "Come into the ark — you and your whole family — because you are the one person in this generation who has lived rightly before Me.
verses.2: Take seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of animal that is not clean, a male and its mate.
verses.3: Also take seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, so their kind can survive on the earth.
verses.4: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will wipe out every living thing I have made from the face of the ground."
verses.5: Noah did everything the LORD told him to do.
verses.6: Noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.7: Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives all went into the ark to escape the flood.
verses.8: Pairs of clean animals and animals that are not clean, birds, and every creature that crawls on the ground
verses.9: came to Noah and went into the ark two by two, male and female, just as God had commanded.
verses.10: After seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.11: It happened when Noah was 600 years old, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month. On that day all the underground waters burst open and the floodgates of the sky were opened.
verses.12: Rain fell on the earth for forty days and forty nights.
verses.13: On that same day Noah and his sons — Shem, Ham, and Japheth — and Noah's wife and his three sons' wives all entered the ark.
verses.14: They went in with every kind of wild animal, every kind of livestock, every kind of creature that crawls on the earth, and every kind of bird.
verses.15: All creatures that had the breath of life came to Noah and entered the ark two by two.
verses.16: A male and female of every kind of living creature came in, just as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut the door behind them.
verses.17: The flood continued for forty days. The water rose and lifted the ark up off the ground.
verses.18: The water kept rising and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
verses.19: The water rose so high that it covered all the mountains everywhere under the sky.
verses.20: The water rose more than fifteen cubits above the tops of the mountains.
verses.21: Every living thing on earth died — birds, livestock, wild animals, all the small creatures, and all the people.
verses.22: Everything on dry land that breathed air through its nostrils died.
verses.23: Every living thing on the face of the ground was wiped out — people, animals, crawling things, and birds. They were all gone from the earth. Only Noah and those with him in the ark were left.
verses.24: The waters flooded the earth for 150 days.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
